# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in this project, please report it responsibly.

**Full policy:** [isaacadjei.me/security-policy](https://isaacadjei.me/security-policy)

**Contact:** contact@isaacadjei.me

Please do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities. The full policy on this site covers expected response times and the disclosure process.
